title: Find the smallest Divisor
problemStatement: Master “Find the smallest Divisor” (BS on Answers) the way an interviewer expects: classify, brute, optimize, prove.
intuition: "Find the smallest Divisor": monotonic predicate; invariant answer in [lo,hi).

approaches.title: Linear scan

approaches.idea: Lower-bound style for "Find the smallest Divisor".
approaches.code:
def solve(a,x):
    lo,hi=0,len(a)
    while lo<hi:
        mid=(lo+hi)//2
        if a[mid]<x: lo=mid+1
        else: hi=mid
    return lo
